description: Modular .NET libraries for functional C#: Result, Maybe, Any, Rules, Mediator, Validation, Entity, EF Core, Endpoints, Dependency Injection, Resilience and more.
rules: Each CSharpEssentials.* package ships separately on NuGet; install only the packages the code uses.
Return Result or Result<T> from operations that can fail and build failures with the Error factories (Error.Validation, Error.NotFound, Error.Failure) instead of throwing.
Every Result member that returns Task or ValueTask ends in Async; use BindAsync, not Bind, for async lambdas.
